shellCommands.command: cat index.html package.json vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; ls -R src __agent_eval__; for f in $(find src -type f); do echo "--- $f"; cat $f; done

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components | grep -E "^(Flex|Text|Button|Card|Container|Row|Col|Link|Theme)" ; grep -n "variant" build/esm/components/Text/types.d.ts | head

ls build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -rn "TextVariant\b" build/esm/components/Text/*.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "variant" -r build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head; ls build/esm/components/layout 2>/dev/null
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && sed -n 1,80p layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts; grep -n "view\|type\|theme" Card/Card.d.ts | head -20
